nodes.title: Foundation Phase
nodes.description: Foundation Phase (Grades R-3)

nodes.title: Grade 3
nodes.description: Grade 3

nodes.title: English Home Language
nodes.description: English Home Language for Grade 3 — Foundation Phase CAPS. Skills: Listening and Speaking, Phonics, Reading (Shared/Group Guided/Independent), Writing, Handwriting

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 3 English HL Term 1 (45 days; 3-day baseline in Weeks 1-2)

metadata.capsReference: Grade 3 English HL ATP Term 1

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Talks about personal experiences, feelings and opinions; listens to complex sequence of instructions; suggests solutions to problems; uses appropriate language register; develops oral vocabulary

metadata.capsReference: Listening and Speaking

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Revises single letters and consonant/vowel digraphs from Grade 2; consonant digraphs (sh-, -sh-, ch-, -th-, wh-); recognises rhyming words (blow/flow/glow); builds 3-5 letter words; sorts alphabetically; spells 10 words per week

metadata.capsReference: Phonics: digraphs revision, rhyming words, spelling

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: enlarged text/poem; main idea; higher-order questions; text features; Group Guided: builds sight vocabulary; phonics/structural analysis; self-correcting; shows understanding of punctuation; Independent: picture books, crosswords, classroom reading corner

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared, Group Guided, Independent Reading

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Draws pictures and sequences text; writes own news or creative story (at least paragraph of 8 sentences); uses capital letters, full stops, question marks, commas, exclamation marks, inverted commas; builds word bank

metadata.capsReference: Writing: creative story, punctuation range

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Joined script or cursive writing; uses handwriting tools (pencil, eraser, ruler); consistent formation and spacing; increasing writing speed

metadata.capsReference: Handwriting: joined script/cursive

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 3 English HL Term 2 (49 days)

metadata.capsReference: Grade 3 English HL ATP Term 2

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Listens to more complex instructions; oral presentation (Show and Tell); cause and effect stories; suggests solutions to word problems in Mathematics; uses language appropriately in different contexts

metadata.capsReference: Listening and Speaking: oral presentation, Show and Tell

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Rhyming words (blow/flow/found); various spelling choices for sounds (ow/ou/found); digraphs ff (ph/gh); builds words using phonic skills; spells words correctly; informal tests and dictation

metadata.capsReference: Phonics: spelling patterns, ph/gh digraphs, dictation

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: poems, big books, posters, electronic texts; graphical texts; table of contents/index/page numbers; higher-order questions; Group Guided: fluency, expression, structural analysis, self-correcting, diagrams; Independent: Shared Reading sessions, story books, readers

metadata.capsReference: Reading: Shared, Group Guided, Independent Reading

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: At least two paragraphs (10+ sentences); personal experiences and school event; writing frame; expressive texts (story/familiar story); complex tenses (present/past progressive); nouns/adjectives/verbs/adverbs; reads and edits own writing

metadata.capsReference: Writing: paragraphs, expressive texts, complex tenses

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Lower and upper case in joined script or cursive; transcribes words and sentences correctly in joined script/cursive; consistent letter formation

metadata.capsReference: Handwriting: joined script/cursive upper and lower case

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 3 English HL Term 3 (48 days)

metadata.capsReference: Grade 3 English HL ATP Term 3

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Oral presentation: tells news or experience logically; ever-increasing vocabulary; suggests solutions to word problems; puts events in logical sequence; gives useful feedback to peers

metadata.capsReference: Listening and Speaking: oral presentation, logical sequencing

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: All vowel/consonant blends learnt; silent letters (k as in know, l as in half, b as in comb, w as in write, h as in hour); words pronounced same but spelt differently (pair/hair/hare); builds words using phonic skills; spells correctly; informal tests and dictation

metadata.capsReference: Phonics: silent letters, homophones, dictation

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: range of text types — plays and different types of poems; interprets graphical texts (advertisement pictures, graphs, charts); answers higher-order questions; Group Guided: self-correcting methods, fluency/expression/pronunciation; Independent: Shared Reading, story books, readers, reads aloud to partner

metadata.capsReference: Reading: plays, poems, graphical texts, independent

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Personal texts in different forms (diary entry, letter to relative, description); summarises using mind maps/tables/notices/diagrams/charts; uses different sentence types (statements/questions/commands); correct punctuation; nouns/pronouns/adjectives/verbs; uses conjunctions ('and', 'but')

metadata.capsReference: Writing: diary, letter, description, summarising

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Makes transition to joined script/cursive; copies written text from board, textbooks, work cards with correct letter formation and spacing in joined script or cursive

metadata.capsReference: Handwriting: transition to cursive, copy from board

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 3 English HL Term 4 (48 days)

metadata.capsReference: Grade 3 English HL ATP Term 4

nodes.title: Listening and Speaking
nodes.description: Oral presentation; uses language terms (subject/verb/object/question/statement/command/synonym/exclamation mark); engages in conversation as social skill; uses language imaginatively (jokes/riddles); tells story with beginning/middle/end using descriptive language

metadata.capsReference: Listening and Speaking: oral presentation, language terms

nodes.title: Phonics
nodes.description: Revise all phonics learnt; patterns (-igh [high], -ough [tough], -eigh [neigh], -augh [caught]); synonyms and antonyms; prefixes (un-, re-) and suffixes (-ful, -ness); breaks down multi-syllabic words (re-mem-ber); builds words; spells correctly

metadata.capsReference: Phonics: patterns, prefixes, suffixes, multi-syllabic words

nodes.title: Reading — Shared, Group Guided and Independent
nodes.description: Shared Reading: fiction/non-fiction/newspapers/articles/dialogues/graphical texts as whole class; Group Guided: fluency/speed/expression, structural analysis/comprehension, self-correcting strategies, plays word games; Independent: more complex texts — magazines, comics, simple fiction/non-fiction from different cultures

metadata.capsReference: Reading: variety of text types, fluency, complex texts

nodes.title: Writing
nodes.description: Uses pre-writing strategies to gather info; talks to partner; creates mind map; writes about personal experiences in different forms (short newspaper article); uses apostrophes in contractions; sequences information; uses conjunctions for compound sentences

metadata.capsReference: Writing: pre-writing strategies, newspaper article, compound sentences

nodes.title: Handwriting
nodes.description: Focuses on increasing writing speed while maintaining neatness and legibility; copies written text correctly in joined script or cursive; consistent and fluent letter formation

metadata.capsReference: Handwriting: speed, neatness, joined script/cursive
